title: Looking inside and beyond eye fixations in reading
title_zh: 阅读中眼动停留的内部与外部机制
abstract: Co-registration of neural and behavioral measures is key in developing a holistic understanding of reading. However, researchers must study not only neural effects inside fixations, early enough to initiate saccade decisions, but also later effects that are linguistically driven. Furthermore, researchers must not only use co-registration to allow for naturalistic reading but also to look beyond individual fixations to examine the coupling between temporally extended neural language processing and saccade decisions. Such an approach has revealed that saccade decisions are triggered at an intermediate point of lexical processing, followed by complete recognition and integration of a word into its context. This account can resolve the apparent paradox that the eyes can move through text faster than the brain understands it.
abstract_zh: 神经与行为测量的同步记录是构建阅读整体理解的关键。然而，研究者不仅需要考察停留期间的神经效应——足够早以启动眼跳决策——还要关注随后由语言驱动的后期效应。此外，研究者不仅要利用同步记录实现自然阅读，还要超越单个停留，探究延伸时间尺度的神经语言处理与眼跳决策之间的耦合。此类方法揭示，眼跳决策在词汇处理的中间阶段被触发，随后完成对词语的完整识别并将其整合到语境中。该解释可解决眼睛在文本中移动速度快于大脑理解速度的表面悖论。
